project_context: Tender finance management system for Bright India Traders (Textile Trading).
archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) adapted for Finance

typography.instructions: IBM Plex Sans is mandatory for all numbers, tables, and financial data to ensure monospaced-like alignment. Never use Inter for headings.

colors.instructions: No full-screen gradients. Use flat, solid backgrounds. Never use Teal Green or Teal Blue (#1B93A4).

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Grid Mode B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics)
spacing_and_layout.density: Tight. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for grid. Every pixel must be utilized for data.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strictly left-align labels, inputs, and dense content. Right-align numeric values in tables (currency, amounts).
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Use a collapsible left sidebar (w-64 expanded, w-16 collapsed) + top header for user/context.
spacing_and_layout.paddings: Use tight paddings inside table cells (py-2 px-3) to fit more data. Use p-4 to p-6 for cards.

surface_and_borders.border_radius: rounded-sm (4px) or completely square (0px). Do not use soft, highly rounded corners.
surface_and_borders.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 on all cards and table rows.
surface_and_borders.shadows: Remove default soft shadows. Use purely flat design with borders, or an extremely subtle shadow-sm. Add shadow-md ONLY on hover for interactive elements.
surface_and_borders.glassmorphism: FORBIDDEN. Finance apps require absolute optical clarity. Use solid backgrounds.

component_rules.tables: Striped rows (even:bg-slate-50) for readability. Sticky headers. Right-align all currency columns. Use Shadcn Table.
component_rules.cards: Cardless or flat cards with sharp 1px borders. No inner padding for tables inside cards (flush to edges).
component_rules.forms: Use dense grid layouts for forms (e.g., 3 columns for Transaction Ledger entry). Shadcn Input, Select, DatePicker.
component_rules.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary buttons are deep indigo (#1E1B4B).
component_rules.tabs: Override default Shadcn tabs to be dense. h-8 instead of h-9.
component_rules.charts: Use Recharts. Use monochromatic shades of Indigo for standard data, strictly Red/Green for P&L data.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle cotton texture (opacity 3%) can be applied to the login screen background to nod to the textile industry, but keep internal dashboard completely clean.
visual_enhancers.currency: Format all monetary values using Indian Rupee (₹). Ensure commas follow the Indian numbering system (e.g., ₹ 1,50,000).

accessibility_and_motion.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Red/Green must have clear icons (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) next to them, never rely on color alone.
accessibility_and_motion.hover_states: Clearly define hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100) for all interactive table rows and buttons.
accessibility_and_motion.motion: Minimalist. Entrance fade-in for charts. No bouncy animations.
accessibility_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='approve-tender-btn').

login_sidebar.description: Corporate office meeting, represents the B2B trading context. Use as a large side panel on the login screen.

texture_overlay.description: Subtle cotton texture. Can be blended at 2-5% opacity over the login panel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize data density. The user is managing complex financial ledgers.
Ensure all numbers align properly (use tabular-nums utility if needed) and are formatted as ₹ XX,XX,XXX.
Build a robust Sidebar navigation + Topbar layout structure.
Transaction Ledger must have dropdowns for Stage, Category, and Vendor.
For the EBG (Earnest Bank Guarantee) Register, clearly highlight active vs expired guarantees.
Use Lucide-React (already installed) for clean, technical icons.
DO NOT use generic centered marketing layouts for the dashboard. It must look like a serious ERP.
Use sonner for toast notifications on save/approve actions.
universal_guidelines: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make it distinctive.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surfaces flat (borders over shadows).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Main agent must use provided image URLs and NEVER use placeholder URLs.
